biological.citation: KLF7 regulates super-enhancer-driven IGF2BP2 overexpression to promote the progression of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (PMID: 38443991)
biological.summary: KLF7 acts as a transcription factor that directly binds to the promoter and super-enhancer regions of IGF2BP2 to induce its transcription. KLF7 expression positively correlates with IGF2BP2 abundance in HNSCC, and patients with high expression of both genes show poorer prognosis. Mechanistic studies used ChIP-qPCR and dual-luciferase reporter assays to demonstrate direct KLF7-DNA binding.

biological.citation: HMGB1-mediated elevation of KLF7 facilitates hepatocellular carcinoma progression and metastasis through upregulating TLR4 and PTK2 (PMID: 37554278)
biological.summary: KLF7 functions as a transcriptional activator that directly transactivates TLR4 and PTK2 expression. HMGB1 upregulates KLF7 through the TLR4/RAGE-PI3K-AKT-NF-κB pathway, forming a positive feedback loop. KLF7 expression correlates with cytoplasmic HMGB1, p-p65, TLR4, and PTK2 levels in human HCC samples.

biological.citation: KLF7-regulated ITGA2 as a therapeutic target for inhibiting oral cancer stem cells (PMID: 40316546)
biological.summary: KLF7 directly regulates ITGA2 expression by binding to its promoter, as demonstrated by chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing and dual-luciferase assays. KLF7 maintains cancer stem cell stemness in OSCC through ITGA2-mediated activation of PI3K-AKT, MAPK, and Hippo signaling pathways upon collagen binding.

biological.citation: KLF7 Promotes Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression Through Regulating SLC1A5-Mediated Tryptophan Metabolism (PMID: 39648156)
biological.summary: KLF7 acts as a transcriptional activator that directly binds to the promoter of SLC1A5 to upregulate its expression. KLF7 promotes HCC progression by regulating tryptophan metabolism through SLC1A5-mediated uptake, with downstream effects on serotonin production and cell proliferation/migration.

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes colon adenocarcinoma progression through the PDGFB signaling pathway (PMID: 38164176)
biological.summary: KLF7 specifically binds to the PDGFB promoter region (TGGGTGGAG motif) to promote PDGFB transcription and secretion. Secreted PDGFB activates MAPK/ERK, PI3K/AKT, and JAK/STAT3 signaling through PDGFRβ to drive COAD progression. KLF7 overexpression correlates with clinicopathological features of COAD.

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes neuroblastoma differentiation through the GTPase signaling pathway by upregulating neuroblast differentiation-associated protein AHNAKs and glycerophosphodiesterase GDPD5 (PMID: 38924469)
biological.summary: KLF7 is a neuroblastoma super-enhancer-associated transcription factor that promotes neuroblastoma differentiation independently of and cooperatively with retinoic acid. KLF7 directly binds to promoters of AHNAK, AHNAK2, and GDPD5 to regulate their expression and alter GTPase activity. High KLF7 expression is associated with favorable clinical outcomes in neuroblastoma.
biological.sample_size: Neuroblastoma cell lines and clinical samples

biological.citation: KLF7 is associated with poor prognosis and regulates migration and adhesion in tongue cancer (PMID: 33393169)
biological.summary: KLF7 is upregulated in TSCC and promotes cell migration and adhesion. RNA-seq and KEGG pathway analysis revealed that KLF7-altered genes are enriched in extracellular matrix-receptor interactions and focal adhesion pathways. KLF7 expression correlates with T and N stages and is associated with worse overall survival.
biological.sample_size: 127 TSCC samples from public database; 21 tongue cancer samples

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes adipocyte inflammation and glucose metabolism disorder by activating the PKCζ/NF-κB pathway (PMID: 37342904)
biological.summary: KLF7 upregulates PKCζ expression through direct promoter binding (confirmed by luciferase reporter and ChIP assays) and activates the PKCζ/NF-κB pathway to promote IL-6 expression in adipocytes. KLF7, PKCζ, p-IκB, p-p65, and IL-6 expression are significantly increased in epididymal white adipose tissue of high-fat diet-fed mice and decreased in KLF7 fat conditional knockout mice.
biological.sample_size: 3T3-L1 adipocytes; HEK-293T cells; mouse adipose tissue

biological.citation: Expression and Clinical Significance of Serum Krüppel-Like Factor 7 (KLF7) in NSCLC Patients (PMID: 35936369)
biological.summary: Serum KLF7 levels are significantly elevated in NSCLC patients compared to healthy controls and correlate with tumor differentiation degree and TNM stage. Cox regression analysis identified KLF7 as an independent risk factor for 3-year recurrence and metastasis in NSCLC patients, independent of gender, age, smoking history, and tumor diameter.

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes progression of Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma by remodeling tumor immune microenvironment (PMID: 41482204)
biological.summary: KLF7 is an oncogenic transcription factor that directly transactivates LOX expression in HNSCC cells. KLF7-driven LOX expression promotes extracellular matrix crosslinking to create a stiff microenvironment that recruits tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), which suppress CD8+ T cell-mediated killing. The KLF7/LOX/TAM axis represents a therapeutic vulnerability in HNSCC.
biological.sample_size: HNSCC clinical samples and cell lines

biological.citation: ASHG 2016 - De novo alterations in KLF7 are a novel cause of intellectual disability, psychiatric and neuromuscular issues
biological.summary: De novo missense mutations in KLF7 (p.T137M, p.P139S in F-box motif; p.D264N in zinc finger DNA-binding domain) cause intellectual disability, developmental delay, abnormal muscle tone, feeding/swallowing issues, and psychiatric features. KLF7 is implicated in neurogenesis, axon guidance, and skeletal muscle differentiation based on mouse and in vitro studies.
